We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Python/Generative AI Developer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying advanced Generative AI models and applications, including sophisticated chat interfaces. You will work on various aspects of the AI lifecycle, from research and prototyping to production deployment, contributing to solutions that drive innovation and efficiency within our organization.
Responsibilities :
Design, develop, and implement Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, GANs, VAEs, Diffusion Models) using Python and relevant deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Integrate Generative AI capabilities into existing systems and develop new AI-powered applications.
Build and maintain dynamic and responsive chat interfaces for Generative AI solutions using React, incorporating features such as HTTP streaming for real-time updates, asynchronous processing for efficient user experience, secure file upload capabilities, and advanced chat formatting.
Conduct research and stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in Generative AI, natural language processing, and machine learning.
Optimize and fine-tune AI models for performance, scalability, and efficiency.
Develop robust data pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment of AI models.
Collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers, and product managers to define requirements and deliver solutions.
Ensure the responsible and ethical deployment of AI models, adhering to best practices and regulatory guidelines.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, adhering to software development best practices.
Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural discussions, and provide technical guidance.
Troubleshoot and debug AI models and applications, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks and issues.
Required Qualifications :
5-8 years of professional experience in software development, with a strong focus on Python.
Proven experience with Generative AI models, including hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) or other generative architectures.
Experience with Google ADK or similar Google AI/ML platforms and SDKs.
Understanding of Deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or JAX.
Strong front-end development skills, particularly with React, for building interactive user interfaces.
Demonstrable experience in implementing chat functionalities, including handling HTTP streaming, asynchronous operations, managing file uploads, and applying various chat formatting techniques.
Solid understanding of machine learning principles, algorithms, and data structures.
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and MLOps practices for deploying and managing AI models.
Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Education:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

You will lead the full software development lifecycle, from architecture through delivery, while mentoring developers and shaping engineering standards. This role offers the opportunity to influence how large-scale, mission-critical applications are built and scaled across the organization.
Responsibilities
Lead the design and development of Java-based application systems, ensuring solutions align with Citi's overall technology architecture.
Partner with cross-functional management teams to integrate new products and deliver system enhancements that improve business processes.
Resolve complex, high-impact technical issues by evaluating business and system processes against industry standards.
Define coding, testing, debugging, and implementation standards that raise the quality and reliability of applications.
Analyze complex technical challenges and develop practical solutions that address root causes rather than symptoms.
Mentor and coach mid-level developers and analysts, guiding their technical growth and allocating project work.
Apply sound judgment to day-to-day technical decisions, helping safeguard Citi and its clients by following relevant laws, regulations, and policies.

8+ years of experience as a Software Engineer or Developer using Java, with a clear command of data structures and object-oriented design principles.
Background in cloud-native development and container orchestration tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or serverless platforms.

Familiarity with front-end technologies such as Angular, JavaScript, or TypeScript, and CI/CD pipelines such as Tekton, Harness, CircleCI, or Jenkins.
Experience working within agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban, alongside exposure to database technologies including RDBMS, NoSQL, Oracle, MySQL, or MongoDB, and event-driven architectures such as Kafka or IBM MQ.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent practical experience.

Familiarity with API management, infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation, and job scheduling tools such as Autosys.
Knowledge of security, observability, and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, ELK, or CloudWatch.

Citi invests in your growth as a technologist, giving you the tools, mentorship, and global scale to advance your career while building solutions that matter.
Work in a hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.
Access ongoing learning and development programs that strengthen your technical and leadership skills.

Benefit from competitive compensation and resources that support your financial wellbeing.

Citi is looking for a Digital Software Engineer Senior Manager to design, build, and deliver complex software applications within a high-performing Technology team that directly supports business-critical systems across the firm. In this role, you will operate as a subject matter expert, shaping end-to-end application development from system architecture through to deployment and ongoing support. You will influence technical standards, mentor peers, and collaborate across technology and business teams to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and aligned to real business outcomes.
Responsibilities:
Accountable for executing and driving application design and development efforts to completion, serving as a development lead on medium-scale projects and supporting the execution of larger efforts.
Proficient at operating with considerable autonomy and discretion as you will significantly influence the way an application is designed and developed by providing subject specific expertise and an advanced level of understanding of application programming principles.
Sought after due to ability to analyze and troubleshoot coding, application performance and design challenges.
Capable of research in root cause of development and performance concerns as well as the resolution of defects.
Have a deep understanding of the technical requirements for the solutions being built.
Understand engineering needs including those required to build, maintain, and operate the system through all phases of its life.
Proficient in information modeling, data structures and algorithms.
Understand maintenance characteristics, runtime properties and dependencies that exist in support of your system’s software. These dependencies will include but not limited to: hardware, platform, operating system, performance and load requirements, as well as contingencies with upstream and downstream systems.
Demonstrate an advanced understanding of supported main system flows and possess a comprehensive understanding of how the system and others (i.e. architecture or infrastructure) collectively integrate to contribute towards achieving business objectives. Using this expertise, assist with the development of standards for coding, testing, debugging and implementation. This will ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint.
Participate in design discussions as a Development Lead and as such will play the part of a key decision maker in driving design decisions. This is evidenced by your knowledge of the application code details and your experience with the technology and teams engaged.
Work with limited guidance, seeking guidance only as needed as the development and delivery strategy is defined; the design is not.
Exhibit the ability to turn complex application design into a well written application.
Partner with industry vendors that provide technology or user experience design components that support our Digital architecture and work with vendors on our implementation plans and roadmaps identifying partnership opportunities to increase our development velocity and our learnings.
Participates in the full development life cycle, identify dependencies between agile and waterfall delivery, working within broadly defined parameters, including test plan execution and software quality needs
Directly impact the business by influencing strategic functional decisions through advice, counsel or provided services. This will require persuading and influencing others through strong and comprehensive communication and diplomacy skills.
Communicate progress, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, identify, assess, track and mitigate issues/risks at multiple levels.
Recognize discordant views and take part in constructive dialog to resolve them.
Work across teams to optimize processes.
Regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved mechanisms for visibility ensuring your program stays aligned with organization objectives.
Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations.
Work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery.
Streamline and / or eliminate excess process in any area of architecture, build, delivery, production operations environment, or business area where the same efforts (or issues) are repeated year-over-year.
Share knowledge with the team in various forums (brown bags, engineering forums etc.) and demonstrate a higher level of knowledge through industry certifications
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications :
6+ years of development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Java backend engineering as the primary technical discipline.
Demonstrated leadership and project management skills.
Deep proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, including the design and delivery of microservices-based, production-grade backend systems.
Solid experience building frontend applications with Angular, including in-depth knowledge of JavaScript and functional programming patterns.
Demonstrated ability to apply DevSecOps principles, security-first development practices, and CI/CD tooling throughout the software development lifecycle.
Experience writing and maintaining comprehensive UI tests, with a consistent focus on quality and reliability.
Fundamental database concepts and experience with a relational database (MSSQL, Oracle) or NoSQL platforms.
Fundamental understanding of and experience with cloud platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes.
A good understanding of Standard, Enterprise Design Patterns, and principles.
Should have good understanding of Containers, docker deployment.
Strong knowledge with testing frameworks like JUNIT, Cucumber, Jasmine/Mocha.
Preferred experience in High-Speed Messaging platforms such as KAFKA.
Experience with Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery technologies and tools.
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication.
Ability to work effectively with limited direct supervision, take end-to-end ownership of deliverables, and operate confidently in an agile development environment.
Manage all phases of the software development lifecycle, from feasibility assessment and technical planning through to construction, testing, implementation, and post-go-live support.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. Position Overview:
The Site Reliability Engineer is based in North America (NAM) to serve as the regional pillar of our global reliability engineering function within Markets Technology. In this role, you will be part of a distributed, high-impact three-person global team, working closely with your counterparts in EMEA and APAC to provide resilient, round-the-clock ("follow-the-sun") operational excellence, infrastructure automation, and architecture reliability for mission-critical enterprise systems.
As a VP-level Individual Contributor, you will operate as a technical authority for the NAM region. You will champion modern SRE principles—bridging software engineering, systems architecture, and production operations—to maximize service uptime, optimize performance, and drive end-to-end automation across hybrid-cloud and on-premises environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Reliability Engineering, Observability & Incident Governance
SLO/SLI Framework Ownership: Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets across core regional and global platforms in collaboration with development and product teams.
Incident Management & Root Cause Elimination: Act as the Tier-3 technical escalation authority for critical production incidents during NAM market/operational hours. Conduct blameless Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and implement preventative architectural and automated remediations.
Advanced Observability: Design and maintain unified monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting ecosystems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog) to ensure deep system telemetry and proactive anomaly detection.
Automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Continuous Delivery
Toil Elimination: Identify repetitive operational tasks and eliminate toil through software engineering, creating resilient tools, automated runbooks, and self-healing infrastructure.
Infrastructure as Code & Configuration: Architect, provision, and maintain secure, highly available cloud and bare-metal environments.
CI/CD Pipeline Reliability: Partner with application engineering teams to design robust, secure, and automated release deployment patterns (Canary, Blue/Green, Feature Flags) that minimize change failure rates and deployment friction.
Global "Follow-the-Sun" Collaboration & Hand-Offs
Global Continuity: Execute structured, high-context operational and incident handoffs with counterparts in EMEA and APAC, ensuring seamless 24/7 reliability coverage without requiring overnight on-call shifts.
Global Standardization: Align regional operational standards, automation scripts, and disaster recovery procedures with the global pod to maintain parity across regions.
Regional Change & Regulatory Windows: Oversee critical change execution, patching, and deployment windows specific to the NAM time zone and regulatory environment.
Architectural Resilience, Chaos Engineering & Capacity Planning
Resiliency by Design: Partner with Solutions Architects to review system designs against non-functional requirements (NFRs), high availability (HA), and multi-region failover capabilities.
Capacity & Cost Optimization: Forecast infrastructure capacity requirements based on business traffic growth patterns, optimizing compute, storage, and networking utilization across NAM data centers and cloud zones.
Qualifications:
Experience
Experience Level: 6+ years of professional experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Architecture, or Systems Engineering, with at least 4+ years dedicated to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or Production Engineering at a senior/lead level.
Industry Background: Prior experience in highly regulated, mission-critical, or high-throughput environments (e.g., Financial Services, FinTech, Tier-1 Tech, Enterprise SaaS) is strongly preferred.
Technical Competencies
Software Development / Scripting: Advanced proficiency in at least one core programming language (Python, Java,) and shell scripting (Bash) for tooling, automation, and API integration.
Cloud & Container Orchestration: Deep expertise with Kubernetes (OpenShift), Docker, and enterprise cloud platforms (AWS).
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Extensive experience writing and maintaining modular Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible codebases.
Operating Systems & Networking: In-depth knowledge of Linux/Unix internals (kernel tuning, I/O bottlenecks, memory management), networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, Load Balancing, TLS/mTLS, HTTP/gRPC), and distributed system failure modes.
Database & Storage Systems: Familiarity with relational databases and distributed data stores/messaging systems from a reliability, backup, replication, and failover perspective.
Observability Tooling: Hands-on experience configuring and scaling telemetry stacks.
Leadership & Interpersonal Attributes (Individual Contributor)
High Autonomy & Ownership: Demonstrated capability to operate independently as the sole regional subject matter expert while maintaining strong synergy with global peers.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical issues and trade-offs to senior leadership and cross-functional engineering teams.
Problem-Solving & Bias for Action: Calm under pressure during high-severity production incidents, with an analytical mindset focused on data-driven decision-making.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) & Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) across NAM service components.
Service Availability & SLO Attainment against target thresholds.
Toil Reduction Rate: Quantifiable percentage of operational tasks automated and transitioned to self-service.
Change Failure Rate & Rollback Frequency: Reduction in deployment-related service disruptions.
Quality of Global Handoffs: Zero-drop continuity across NAM/EMEA/APAC shift transitions.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master’s degree preferred

Strategize & Collaborate: Partner directly with business leaders and product managers to identify high-impact AI opportunities, define project roadmaps, and translate strategic business needs into a coherent technical vision.

You are a strategic thinker and a master builder , capable of seeing the long-term vision and diving deep into the technical details to make it a reality.

About the Team:
The Low Latency Trading Infrastructure Engineer is a rare combination of deep technical specialist and mission-critical operator — a professional whose expertise sits at the intersection of hardware engineering, financial markets technology, and performance science. This role sits at the heart of Citi's Global Equity Markets technology organization, responsible for designing, delivering, and sustaining the ultra-low latency infrastructure that powers one of the world's most demanding electronic trading environments. The candidate we seek does not merely maintain infrastructure — they engineer deterministic performance at nanosecond precision, shaping the technical foundation upon which Citi competes in global markets. This is a position for seasoned practitioners who have thrived in high-frequency trading firms, exchange technology groups, or HPC environments, and who bring a rare depth of knowledge spanning bare-metal compute, kernel-bypass networking, FPGA-enabled hardware, and exchange colocation operations.
The successful candidate will operate at the nexus of infrastructure engineering and trading performance, collaborating closely with application development teams, trading desks, risk and compliance stakeholders, and exchange and colocation facility partners. They will drive end-to-end latency optimization across the full trading stack — from BIOS tuning and NIC configuration through to circuit provisioning and market data distribution — while ensuring that every environment meets Citi's stringent standards for security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance. Their impact will be felt in every microsecond saved and every market opportunity captured, contributing directly to Citi's standing as a premier global equities trading institution.
Technical Responsibilities:
Design low-latency compute topologies including bare-metal servers, NICs, kernel bypass technologies such as DPDK and Solarflare, and FPGA/co-location hardware
Evaluate CPU microarchitecture, NUMA topology, cache behavior, and memory bandwidth characteristics for trading workloads
Define hardware and firmware standards in partnership with vendors including Dell, HPE, Mellanox/NVIDIA Networking, Arista, Cisco, and Juniper
Design and maintain custom server build patterns tailored to the low-latency trading platform, distinct from Citi's standard enterprise server catalog
Establish and enforce standards for low latency Linux, Windows, and Microservice infrastructure, including OS optimization, kernel bypass technologies, CPU isolation, NUMA optimization, interrupt tuning, and deterministic performance engineering
Build repeatable benchmarking harnesses to measure tick-to-trade latency, jitter, and throughput
Conduct comparative hardware, firmware, and BIOS tuning analysis including CPU pinning, IRQ affinity, C-state/P-state tuning, and huge pages configuration
Correlate benchmark results with real trading telemetry to validate production readiness
Drive packet capture analysis and latency telemetry across the full trading stack
Architect and deliver high-performance colocation environments connecting exchange venues, market data providers, and internal trading systems
Implement ultra-low latency Layer 1/Layer 2 network configurations across trading infrastructure
Execute formal certification test plans for new hardware, firmware, and OS/kernel builds before production introduction
Maintain audit-ready certification documentation aligned to internal risk and compliance standards
Coordinate with Risk, InfoSec, and Exchange/Venue technical teams where co-location or vendor certification is required, including adherence to CAT and MiFID II requirements for time synchronization, monitoring, and reporting
Execute infrastructure provisioning and deployments within air-gapped or network-segmented environments with no direct internet access
Manage image and firmware distribution via approved offline or tightly controlled transfer mechanisms
Apply strict change management and rollback procedures given the production sensitivity of the environment
Deploy and support connectivity circuits to external clients and exchanges, including cross-connect provisioning and handoff validation at specialized and co-located data centers
Lead bare-metal automation, deployment pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code practices using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, and Puppet for rapid, repeatable infrastructure delivery
Manage and configure Active Directory, ISA, DNS, PTP, Remote Access Solutions, and infrastructure management and monitoring technologies such as Lenovo LXCA, HPE OneView, Dell OpenManage Enterprise, and HCL BigFix
Monitor compute health, latency drift, and hardware degradation using specialized low-level telemetry tools
Manage hardware lifecycle refresh planning including hardware aging, EOL firmware tracking, and vendor support contract coordination
Troubleshoot at the hardware, OS, and network stack level under time-sensitive, high-impact conditions, often during live market hours
Manage Kubernetes cluster operations and workload orchestration for trading-adjacent microservice infrastructure
Implement and maintain high-speed interconnects including InfiniBand, RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE), and multicast networking protocols
Non-Technical / Leadership Responsibilities:
Collaborate with application development and support teams to optimize end-to-end trading latency and infrastructure determinism
Participate in incident management and infrastructure resiliency efforts for mission-critical trading environments, including structured post-incident documentation and root cause analysis
Maintain close partnership with software delivery teams, Citi's enterprise technology group, and trading functions throughout the end-to-end platform delivery and deployment lifecycle
Produce meticulous documentation to support audit and regulatory review, including change requests, incident reports, and certification approval packages
Represent engineering requirements and infrastructure risk clearly in written communications to cross-functional partners in Risk, InfoSec, and Compliance
Work with vendor partners, exchange providers, and hardware manufacturers to optimize resiliency and performance, maintaining operational coordination with co-location data center facility operators
Support hardware procurement, vendor engagement, colocation buildout activities, and telecom contract processes as an individual technical contributor
Demonstrate composure under pressure given the financial impact of latency or downtime, and willingness to support off-hours maintenance windows and rapid incident response during market-critical periods
Qualifications:
6+ years of hands-on experience in low latency infrastructure engineering within electronic trading, capital markets, hedge funds, trading venues, or equivalent high-performance financial technology environments
Proven, hands-on experience building and operating exchange colocation environments for Equities or multi-asset electronic trading platforms, including physical rack management, cross-connect provisioning, and circuit validation
Deep technical expertise in low latency network architecture, including ultra-low latency switching platforms, multicast market data distribution, and Precision Time Protocol (PTP) implementation and synchronization
Advanced Linux systems engineering proficiency in RHEL and equivalent distributions, with deep hands-on experience in kernel tuning, CPU pinning and isolation, NUMA optimization, interrupt affinity (IRQ), C-state/P-state management, and huge pages configuration
Hands-on experience with kernel bypass and packet acceleration technologies including DPDK, XDP, Solarflare OpenOnload, and FPGA-based NIC solutions, with demonstrated ability to reduce stack-level latency to sub-microsecond levels
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or equivalent languages, with experience building tooling for benchmarking, telemetry collection, and infrastructure provisioning in air-gapped or tightly controlled environments
Strong experience with infrastructure automation tools including Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet for bare-metal provisioning, firmware management, and repeatable deployment pipelines in trading-sensitive environments
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipeline design and execution using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD, including build, test, and deployment automation for infrastructure-as-code workflows
Experience with container orchestration platforms including Kubernetes (OpenShift or Amazon EKS preferred), including deployment, scaling, node affinity configuration, and low-latency workload scheduling
Proficiency with high-speed interconnect protocols and hardware including InfiniBand, RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE), and multicast networking, applied to market data distribution and inter-system communication
Experience with low-level telemetry and monitoring tooling, including packet capture analysis tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump, hardware performance counters, and latency measurement frameworks relevant to tick-to-trade profiling
Strong understanding of modern low latency hardware platforms, NICs, and FPGA-enabled compute environments, with experience evaluating and benchmarking hardware from vendors including Dell, HPE, Mellanox/NVIDIA Networking, Arista, Cisco, and Juniper
Familiarity with exchange connectivity rules, CAT regulatory requirements, MiFID II time synchronization standards, and internal change-control/compliance frameworks as they pertain to trading infrastructure
Meticulous documentation habits and strong written communication skills for change requests, incident reports, and certification approval packages
Experience supporting hardware procurement, vendor coordination, colocation buildouts, and telecom processes in a financial services context

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience in a highly specialized low-latency or high-performance computing environment

The Cybersecurity Architect, PQC will report into the Senior Cryptography Expert as part of CISOs Cryptographic Security Center of Excellence. The person in this position will be supporting Citi’s Quantum Readiness Program and the industry movement to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). This position requires commercial awareness in support of discussing PQC developments with vendors and specifically around those products which are used by Citi technologists. Expert senior stakeholder communication and diplomacy skills are required to guide, influence, and convince others whether they be colleagues in other areas or occasional external customers. This role brings a significant impact on the area through complex deliverables in terms of cryptographic reviews, structured migration/mitigation plans, and coordination with application owners and the Cryptographic Security Center of Excellence all to support the delivery of Citi’s Quantum Readiness Program. The ideal candidate will provide advice and counsel related to the cryptographic technology or operations of the business. While this is an individual contributor Subject Matter Expert (SME) role, the position will work across all lines of business, all applications, and geographies. In addition, this role will face-off to external bodies & groups dealing with cryptographic-related efforts such as NIST, BPI, ETSI, CABForum, PKI Consortium and local regulators.
Responsibilities
Operate as a Subject Matter Expert on Traditional and Post-Quantum Cryptography algorithms, practices, and use cases.
Support Citi's Quantum Readiness Program to ensure Citi's data is protected from cryptographically relevant quantum computing threats.
Co-own the PQC readiness view of the cryptographic inventory. Reconcile inventory tool outputs with discovery tool outputs to reduce or eliminate manual enrichment required for PQC reporting.
Provide support and effective challenge to business and technology representatives and leadership on the secure implementation of cryptography.
Demonstrate deep understanding of practical cryptography and the impacts and considerations of migrating to post-quantum use cases.
Deliver professional presentations on emerging cryptography trends and key topics, tailoring business-impact messaging to different levels of expertise and leadership.
Play a key role in developing and communicating a risk-based, data-driven governance strategy and roadmap for Citi's Quantum Readiness Program, in partnership with architecture, engineering, operations, information security officers, and other stakeholders.
Provide technical expertise in symmetric and asymmetric encryption, digital signatures, hashing, Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), and related key and certificate management concerns.

Work with application, infrastructure, architecture, and engineering teams to translate system and business requirements into implementation requirements, helping to embed PQC and crypto-agility requirements into existing roadmaps, technology refresh, and modernization efforts.
Build internal relationships and help drive program-level timelines and requirements across the enterprise globally.
Participate in new product and vendor assessments and develop PoCs and trials to support deployment and adoption decisions.
Partner with Citi's Third-Party Risk Management and Supplier teams to assess vendor PQC roadmaps. Ensure PQC requirements are incorporated into contracts and renewals.
Establish additional reporting and metrics, including KPIs and KRIs, for governance, senior leadership, internal audit, and regulatory reporting.
Monitor NIST, IETF, CNSA, regulatory, and industry developments to determine the impact of these developments on internal guidance and program timelines.
Respond to the internal and external/regulatory requests regarding program readiness and alignment.

6+ years' experience in cybersecurity, cryptography, or a control-related function at enterprise organizations with knowledge and/or prior consulting support of Post-Quantum migration strategies and timelines.
Ability to architect PQC deployments within existing infrastructure use cases, e.g. PKI, ATM, Payments and hardware components, e.g. HSMs, Load Balancers, Network Devices, and embedded endpoints.
Experience working with 3rd party / vendor tools and applications with respect to their cryptographic support and upgrade pathways.
Working knowledge of public key infrastructure (PKI), application and data security, symmetric encryption systems, and implementation of these.
Expert diplomacy skills with the ability to guide, influence, and convince colleagues across the global organization with engagement of both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong understanding of operating systems, network security infrastructure, and one or more scripting languages (e.g. Python, bash, etc.).
Strong understanding of AI capabilities and utilization. Able to leverage Citi's generative AI tools to accelerate deliverables.
Prior Enterprise systems implementation and / or migration and strategy development experience a plus.
Solid understanding of cryptography, algorithms, and implementations & maintains/enhances knowledge through research, self-study and engagement.
Solid understanding of technologies where cryptography is leveraged & implemented such as software, networking, identity systems, and data platforms.
Experience with public cloud technologies and their use of cryptography and key management.

Master's degree preferred.

Ensure seamless integration from code commit to production deployment, focusing on speed, quality, and security.
Manage and optimize the build, test, and release processes for all components of the IDP platform, including Python and React JS applications.
OpenShift Deployments:
Manage and automate deployments of microservices and applications to OpenShift clusters.
Implement and maintain deployment strategies such as blue-green, canary, and rolling updates.
Ensure high availability, scalability, and resilience of applications running on OpenShift.
Database Management:
Oversee the management and maintenance of Postgres databases.
Implement and manage database schema changes using Liquibase .
Helm Chart Lifecycle Management:
Lead the authoring, versioning, and release management of Helm charts for all platform services.
Establish and enforce best practices for Helm chart development to ensure reusability and maintainability.
Manage the lifecycle of charts in our Artifactory repository.
Kafka/Messaging Operations:
Oversee the operational health of our Kafka messaging backbone.
Responsible for topic management, including creation, partitioning, and access control.
Perform consumer group tuning and monitoring to ensure optimal performance and data throughput.
Container Governance and Security:
Implement and manage a strict container governance policy.
Integrate automated image scanning ( Snyk/Checkmarx ) into the CI/CD pipeline to identify vulnerabilities.
Manage the container lifecycle within Artifactory , including promotion, retention, and patching strategies for base and application images.
Observability Stack Build-out:
Architect, build, and maintain a comprehensive observability stack using Prometheus , Grafana , and ELK/Splunk .
Develop dashboards, alerts, and logging solutions to provide deep insights into platform health and performance.
Proactively identify and resolve issues through effective monitoring and root cause analysis.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience: 3+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering role.
CI/CD: Proven hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Harness, Tekton, Lightspeed (LSE), and experience with Python and React JS build processes.
Database: Experience with Postgres database management and schema migration using Liquibase .
Containerization: Expert-level knowledge of Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift.
Helm: Demonstrable experience in creating and managing complex Helm charts.
Messaging Systems: Strong operational experience with Kafka, including administration and performance tuning.
Security: Experience with container security scanning tools (e.g., Snyk, Checkmarx) and repository management (e.g., Artifactory).
Observability: Proficiency in setting up and managing monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK stack or Splunk.
Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have)
GenAI/LLM Exposure: Direct experience building, supporting, or working with platforms that utilize Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Python: Advanced proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and developing backend services.
Certifications: OpenShift or Kubernetes certifications (e.g., CKA, CKAD, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration) are a plus.

About the Team
Prime Brokerage Technology delivers the solutions that underpin the operations of our clients and traders, forming the technological backbone of our Prime Finance business. This is an area of significant opportunity, identified as a major growth priority for Citi — with technology serving as the key to unlocking that potential.
Overview
Prime Finance operates in a highly competitive marketplace, delivering Prime Brokerage services to institutional clients such as hedge funds, backed by robust financing and stock borrow capabilities.
Prime Brokerage Technology provides the platforms and solutions that support our clients and traders - the foundation of the Prime Brokerage business. Our clients depend on us to deliver consistently high levels of service, ensuring transactions, payments, and reporting are processed accurately and without failure, every single day.
We are partway through a transformation journey - replacing legacy components with test-driven, cloud-native microservices designed for stability, scalability, and release agility

The Applied AI and Agents Factory brings together ambitious engineers to turn advanced AI capabilities into production-ready solutions. Working directly with business and technology teams, you’ll tackle complex engineering challenges, build intelligent agents and take ideas from initial concept through to live deployment.
This is an opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI engineering, developing systems that go beyond conversational tools to reason, plan and execute multi-step workflows. You’ll take ownership of the full engineering lifecycle, from agent architecture and orchestration to enterprise integration, security and observability.
With a strong focus on hands-on engineering, collaboration and rapid delivery, the Factory gives you the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, influence architectural decisions and help shape reusable tools and engineering standards adopted across Citi.
The Forward Deployed Engineer (C12) is an agile, hands-on software engineer embedded within Line of Business pods. This role is responsible for building agent features and prototypes, constructing automated evaluation testbeds, optimizing prompts and data parsers, and automating continuous testing pipelines to guarantee the accuracy, safety, and reliability of production AI agents.
Responsibilities:
Agent Prototyping & Feature Engineering: Develop and iterate on agent features, prompt templates, system instructions, few-shot examples, and data pre-processing scripts under the guidance of senior team members.
Automated Evaluation Testbeds: Build, calibrate, and execute automated evaluation test suites using enterprise evaluation studios and frameworks (measuring agent task completion, tool call correctness, semantic similarity, latency, and hallucination metrics).
Golden Dataset & Benchmark Curation: Curate, version, and maintain domain-specific golden evaluation datasets, synthetic benchmarks, and edge-case regression testbeds in collaboration with Line of Business domain experts.
CI/CD Test Pipeline Automation: Author and maintain automated test execution scripts within enterprise CI/CD pipelines, enforcing continuous evaluation gates prior to staging and production rollout.
Guardrail & Security Verification: Validate and test AI guardrail policies (prompt injection defenses, toxicity filters, PII redaction) across agent input/output pipelines to ensure safe operation.
Telemetry & Diagnostic Reporting: Monitor agent performance metrics, log evaluations, and generate prompt diagnostic reports to assist squad leads and business stakeholders in optimizing agent behavior.
Agile Pod Participation: Operate with increasing autonomy within fast-paced agile squads, actively contributing to sprint planning, standups, and codebase maintenance.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citi, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications :
Total Experience: 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience (or 2+ years with specialized focus in Python, Java, or Go and Generative AI application development).
Programming Skills: Solid Python, Java, or Go programming proficiency with hands-on experience integrating REST/gRPC APIs, Docker containers, and Git workflows.
AI & Evaluation Literacy: Working knowledge of Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and evaluation methodologies (e.g., semantic similarity, LLM-as-a-judge, benchmark test suites).
CI/CD & DevOps Basics: Experience working with automated test pipelines and CI/CD tools (e.g., Tekton, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness).
Communication & Collaboration: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a methodical, detail-oriented approach to software quality and data integrity.
Education:
Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, or related quantitative discipline
